component.name: Yoru Reader
component.summary: Modern Japanese Light Novel Reader with Kuromoji parser, Yomitan dictionary, and FSRS-6 SRS

description.p: Yoru Reader is an advanced Japanese light novel and document reader built for language learners. It features instant morphological parsing, seamless Yomitan dictionary lookups, pitch accent graphs, Anki Connect integration, and built-in FSRS-6 spaced repetition.

screenshot.caption: Yoru Reader Library and Reading View

description.p: Yoru Reader v1.1.4: Complete Japanese tokenization, Anki Review Heatmap, and live OTA updater.
